scab.definition:
n. someone who works (or provides workers) during a strike
n. the crustlike surface of a healing skin lesion
v. form a scab
scab.translation:
n. 痂, 恶棍, 工贼
vi. 结痂, 当工贼

scabbard.definition: n. a sheath for a sword or dagger or bayonet
scabbard.translation:
n. 鞘
vt. 放入鞘内, 装鞘

scabbards.definition: n. a sheath for a sword or dagger or bayonet

scabbed.definition:
imp. & p. p. of Scab
a. Abounding with scabs; diseased with scabs.
a. Fig.: Mean; paltry; vile; worthless.
scabbed.translation:
a. 结痂的, 生疥癣的, 卑鄙的, 下贱的
[医] 有痂的

scabbier.translation: a. 结痂的；卑劣的；脏兮兮的 (scabby的变形)

scabbiest.translation: a. 结痂的；卑劣的；脏兮兮的 (scabby的变形)

scabbiness.definition: n. The quality or state of being scabby.

scabbing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Scab

scabble.translation: v. (将石)粗加整修,(使石)初具形态

scabby.translation:
a. 结痂的, 下贱的
[医] 痂的, 疥疮的

scabellum.translation: 平衡棒基, 胸像的高垫座

scabicde.translation: [医] 杀疥螨的, 杀疥螨药

scabicide.definition: n a drug that destroys the itch mite that causes scabies

scabies.definition: n. a contagious skin infection caused by the itch mite; characterized by persistent itching and skin irritation
scabies.translation:
n. 疥疮
[医] 疥疮, 疥螨病

scabies crustosa.translation: [医] 结痂性疥疮, 伯克氏疥疮

scabies humida.translation: [医] 湿疥疮, 粟粒疥疮

scabies sicca papulosa.translation: [医] 干丘疹性疥疮, 痒疹

scabiosa.definition: n any of various plants of the genus Scabiosa

scabiosa arvensis.translation: [网络] 山萝卜；山萝卜属植物；柔毛肖乳香

scabiosa atropurpurea.translation: [网络] 松虫草；紫盆花；西洋松虫草

scabious.definition: n. any of various plants of the genus Scabiosa
scabious.translation:
a. 疥疮的, 疥疮状的
[医] 痂的, 疥疮的

scablands.translation: (scabland 的复数) n. 劣地, 崎岖地

scabling.definition: n. A fragment or chip of stone.
scabling.translation: v. （将石）粗加整修, （使石）初具形态( scabble的现在分词 )

scabrock.translation: 岩石劣地, 剥蚀高原

scabrous.definition: s. dealing with salacious or indecent material
scabrous.translation: a. 粗糙的, 多痂的, 难解决的, 猥亵的

scabrousness.definition: n. The quality of being scabrous.

scabs.definition:
n someone who works (or provides workers) during a strike
n the crustlike surface of a healing skin lesion
v form a scab
v take the place of work of someone on strike
scabs.translation: n. （伤口或疮口上所结的）痂( scab的名词复数 ); （植物的）斑点病; 拒不参加罢工的工人; 破坏罢工者
